output.recommendation: The engagement can proceed once the listed conditions are met. Residual risk is Medium and provisional, because three supporting documents are still outstanding and two inherent risk questions remain unanswered. None of the open findings raises residual risk to High, so a risk owner decision is not required at this stage.
output.engagement: PUC plans to engage Halden Advisory for AI governance consulting. This assessment covers the inherent risk of the engagement and a security due diligence questionnaire of 26 questions answered by the vendor. The vendor responses in this sample are illustrative and were written for this portfolio.
output.inherentRisk: Inherent risk is Medium, which places the engagement in Tier 2: a questionnaire based on SIG Lite, with a review every 2 years. Three answers are rated High: confidential information will be shared, the service is treated as business-critical, and sensitive intellectual property is involved. No customer personal information or regulated information is in scope. Whether subcontractors will be involved and whether data will leave the country are still unknown, and both remain open follow-ups.
output.dueDiligence: All 26 questionnaire responses were reviewed and confirmed by the analyst: 22 Satisfactory, one Gap and three Needs evidence. The Gap is data residency: storage of PUC data in Canada is not committed. The Needs evidence items are the ISO/IEC 27001 certificate, the SOC 2 Type II executive summary and a written confirmation about subcontractors. With one Gap, control strength is Adequate.
output.findings: Six findings are open: two unanswered inherent risk questions, the data residency Gap and three outstanding documents. None of them has a named owner yet, so each needs an owner and a due date before the report is approved. The analyst should track the documents and the residency commitment with the vendor before the engagement starts.
output.residual: Residual risk is Medium, the same as inherent risk, because control strength is Adequate. It stays provisional while three Needs evidence items remain open. The next review is due on 2028-11-02.
output.method: Inherent risk was assessed with 16 questions informed by NIST SP 800-161 Rev. 1, and vendor due diligence used a questionnaire based on SIG Lite. AI-assisted suggestions were provided for each questionnaire response, and the analyst reviewed, edited where needed and confirmed every row. Every rating, the tier, control strength, residual risk and the recommendation were calculated by documented rules, not by the AI.
